\C[6](...Wait, maybe they're drinking because they have to shower communally.)
\C[6](That's so real of them actually, me too buddy...)
\C[6](A locker filled with pictures of buff men working on cars.)
\C[6](A locker filled with scratches desperately counting down to a certain day.)
\C[6](A locker filled with various teddy bears?? Why would you need those when
\C[6](A locker filled with landscape paintings of all things?)
\C[6](Maybe they were the one who put the posters around here-)
\C[6](A locker filled with a strange green goop...)
\C[6](A locker filled with pictures of a girl-)
\C[6](Her eyes are scratched out on every photo-)
\C[6](A locker with a tophat at the bottom, laying neatly on top of a towel.)
\C[6](A locker with usual bathing stuff and playing cards.)
\C[6](A locker filled with... Trashy Yuri catgirl manga???)
\C[6]('Keep the socks on: Your guide to Prison love'.)
\C[6](A letter written seemingly in a hurry.)
\C[6]('I survived the experiment, but by the time I got released well...')
\C[6]('Everyone has gotten very strange, I don't know how to describe it.')
\C[6]('I don't have much time but I don't think I'm safe.')
\C[6]('Still, I'm confident I will find a way. I have my head after all.')
\C[6]('Satan is a lesbian'- a thrilling and spicy novel for lonely women.)
\C[6](It seems the monitors here control the heat of water...)
\C[6](It seems the monitors here control the heat of water...)
It’s so dark here… Shinku, find the light switch.
\c[6](I fumbled around in the darkness for a moment, attempting to find it-
but I was quickly interrupted by a voice.)
It appears you’ve entered our domain, a classic blunder!
Mwehehe… Dare take another step and face our wrath!
You’ve kidnapped the wrong dynamic duo, bucko.
Don’t you ‘uhm’ us! We know exactly what you are!
…Can we try that again? I’m not hearing enough FEAR and TERROR in your voice for
Why are you playing into this.
I know you can do better than that! Think of your worst nightmare… We’re that- times…
\c[6](I can’t muster enthusiasm for this unfortunately.)
That’s more like it, you better be wearing socks because you’re gonna shake your
boots so hard they COLLAPSE! Hahaha-!
…Right, I’m going to find the light switch-
No! I mean- I wouldn’t do that if *I* were you, missy.
Take even a STEP towards that light switch to reveal our TERRIBLE but EQUALLY
MARKETABLE true forms and Sugi will activate the trap of a THOUSAND waves!
Before you know it your entire creepy kidnapping basement will be FLOODED like
in the hit book the BIBLE!
…Spoiler alert for the BIBLE by the way!
\c[6](Suddenly I heard the sound of pouring water, Ismene quickly jumped out of the
way and into me slightly- pushing me away from where the water was headed.)
Christ!! Why did you do that?!
And there’s a LOT more where that came from!
Sorry if you did get wet though, we do have towels- FOR A PRICE!
No- Taka! Don’t be nice to them, they’re kidnappers!
Wait, this is a big misunderstanding-
I understand well enough that Miss no-nonsense over here is holding us here for
Ugh, trust me, I don’t need your money.
No- nono, we’ve been kidnapped too! We’re in the same situation here… We don’t
\c[6](The lights to the room quickly flicked on, revealing it to be some sort of
Sorry about that!! We were tryna scare our captours into letting us out!
\c[6](The ‘terrifying’ dynamic duo appeared to just be someone short who had climbed the
walls to turn on the showers whenever they wanted and…)
Oh? You’re fans?! Really? You don’t even look that old, I mean, you look about 30
but that’s better than 70- Uhhhhh, I mean-
Aha, yes! Of course you’re fans, everyone is. Afterall- It is I, *the* Taka Takahiro,
the Ultimate TV Personality! Charmed to meet me, I’m sure.
But please, no pictures, no pictures… Okay some pictures, but DO get
Oh, uh… I don’t watch your shows myself, but my Grandma loves them.
Uhhh- I think you broke him-
Nono, that’s quite alright! But in MY humble, incredible, epic opinion- you should
consider checking out my shows they’re very… Hype.
With many funny moments!\} (A lot of which are relatable.)
How can an opinion be humble and incredible?
Awwe, c’mon, self confidence is important! ‘Specially if you’re a performer!
Are you a performer too, perchance?
Oh! Shoot, sorry- I got real ahead of myself! Forgot my name ‘n stuff-
I’m a Ringleader, yeah! I mainly manage performers, but I do a lotta performing myself!
I’m technically the Ultimate Ringleader, but I’d feel bad saying that’s *my*
Well, I sorta think that title belongs to my entire circus! I wouldn’t be half as
successful without them, they’re like my family!
Awe, jeez- you’ve *gotta* meet some of ‘em when we’re out of here.
Wait! I’m gettin’ distracted again, focus ‘Sugi! *Bonk*
I’m Asuga! If you *really* need my surname for findin’ me online or something
afterwards it’s Saintil, but just call me ‘Sugi! I don’t need a big long fancy
…Well, it’s nice to meet you. You seem nice.
I gotta say, it’s real nice to know we’re not alone here. I was startin’ to think
it was just gonna be me and Taka against the world-
Not that I couldn’t manage that! But y’know, it’s always good to have extra
If you *qualify* to help us, of course.
Well, obviously Sugi we don’t want layabouts and couch-maxxers helping us!
They’d make our whole scheme less intimidating! What if the kidnapper catches
Yes, since you were so intimidating before.
Exactly! We need to screen them, ask them questions… They need to pass!
Sugi, give me a drum roll-
Question One! What is your NAME?
‘Shinku’- hm, it could stand to be more marketable… And what about you,
I have to go do something, Shinku. It’s really important.
\c[6](Ismene quickly walked out of the room… I hope she’s okay?)
Never mind her, it’s time for QUESTION TWO!
How much do you mind being paid an hour?
You’re not getting paid because the hourly rate is ZERO! You should be trying to
escape with us for a good story and freedom, not for any sort of monetary gain.
…Oh, okay! That makes sense, I guess!\} Not all that fair but...
…Wait, so then is the correct answer zero?
*Gasp*! Employers HATE him! How does he keep doing it? Does he know?
Wait, I like Shinky-poo, that’s cute!
Now the FINAL question, what’s your plan to get out of here?
…Well, there’s a small group of us waiting for another woman we met to
finish making a bomb to breach the walls of the facility.
BOMBS! Chat, is this real? This seemingly innocent feminine-boy hides a DARK
secret, and it’s not in his closet!
Wait, where’s this bomb lady? She sounds like a great addition to our team!
Bombs and Broads, those are two of the best things around- combine them and you’ve
got a big hit on your hands no matter what!
I think it’s fair to say you’re on the team, Shinky. If we keep bluffing to *everyone*
then eventually some sort of kidnapper will walk in and fall for our act.
They’ll be shivering in all their timbers, they will RUE the day they dared
It’s like the Monkeys and microwaves analogy!
Pf, Sugi, I think you’ll find it’s ‘Monkeys and Lighters’. You were close though!
So, ready to get started Shinky?
…Uh… I appreciate the offer, it’s a unique plan for sure-
But I’ve got people I promised I’d help, I’m still looking for some painkillers
So I’m going to have to decline… Sorry.
Oh! That’s, fine. Yes, mhm, fine, we’ll manage without you!
The show must go on. It’s easier to keep things simple and small anyway,
A third person would just complicate things anyway. Me and Sugi alone have the
power to bamboozle kidnappers and bust us out of here.
Oh… is your friend okay? If it’s an emergency I might be able to help!
She’ll be fine, but thanks for offering, I just really don’t wanna keep her
Alright, well if you need anythin’ we’re here okay? Just knock three times
so we turn on the light and hold back on the ‘Shower traps’!
Oh! And remember to say the password!
The password is ‘Password’, pretty clever right?
I’m bringin’ in all my security expertise and trickery to ensure our safety!
Alright, we’ve got to get back into position pronto! You best skedaddle out of
here before we turn off the lights again. Professionals only now!
…But if you ever change your mind about being part of the Taka Team(™) just
‘Kay, so I was thinkin’ we need to sound a liiiittle more aggressive- just to
scare them a bit! Not that I don’t *love* what you’re doing so far but-
Oh! Have you reconsidered your position in our plan?
Well, we’d be DELIGHTED to have you on the team! You just have to sign
Uh… The answer is still no, sorry.
OH! That’s… FINE. We didn’t want you ANYWAY! Twinks have been out of
You just be careful, we’ll find the captor soon and get ‘em to be REAL Sorry
You don’t gotta worry about anything, us two have got it sorted!
Uh-huh, which means we get to take all the credit!
I can just see the headline now- ‘Handsome blonde baddie Taka Takahiro
Uh, okay, you two have fun-
Shinku! Is this… The captor?! Have you brought her to us? Wait! You should have
warned us in advance so we could’ve gotten into position- ugh, nevermind!
SPEAK- BLUE THING! Why have you held us here?
No, no, she’s not the captor.
Yeah I love like, kidnapping and stuff. I can’t wait to make so much
money over selling pictures of you.
WHAT NO. Only TAKA TAKAHIRO can take advantage of his DASHING good looks!
You better not be selling my BABY PHOTOS!
Oh, I’m especially selling your baby photos. I’m gonna be rich.
She’s not. Don’t listen to her.
Booooo, you hate me having fun.
Yeah, geez Shinku- god forbid a girl has fun and gets to be silly?
Yeah, no, for real like- do you not want me to have a hobby?
I can’t believe you did that Shinku, I thought you were different!
Heh. I like these two. They’re awesome.
Hey, are you two still hanging in there?
Oh! Yeah, sure! No sign of the kidnapper yet but this guy with a dog tag wandered
in, took one look at us and left.
How are you holdin’ up? Managed to help your friend yet?
…Aha, not quite yet. But I’m working on it.
Well, the offer still stands to join us if you can’t find them! You’d be a
FOOL to deny an opportunity to work with THE Taka Takahiro.
Shinku, you’re not at the hall yet?
I was just checking some things out before I went… Are you two okay?
Yeah, yeah, I just don’t want ‘em to hurt any of my family back at the circus
so I’m gonna hop over there soon-
Well, there’s nothing to worry about! This is obviously just some sort of
set up to some special show my producers have put me on!
There’s no way it could be anything else, that would just be silly!
Still, better safe than sorry! Let’s get to the lecture hall, okay?
